incidents.description: While preparing PR #339, a stale local origin/main ref made the branch diff appear to contain 50 files of other sessions' work. The authors fetched/rebased onto origin/main at 8d0e1ecf and the merged PR contains 6 files.
incidents.notes: The handoff's '36 commits behind' figure was not independently recovered and is not used. Grounding would detect this only if a repo_head/file_exists claim used an independently sourced expected SHA; claims authored from the same stale checkout would MATCH. Existing control: git fetch before computing origin/main diffs. Classified as existing control not invoked early enough, not escaped Grounding authority.

evidence_refs.note: verification.commands_run records rebase onto origin/main 8d0e1ecf after a stale origin/main ref made the diff appear to contain 50 files of other sessions' work

incidents.description: Incident discovered during this review. After git fetch, local main HEAD was 8d0e1ecf (Merge #333) while origin/main was a40d9030 (Merge #339): 9 commits behind, 0 ahead. The VECTOR-CROSS-REPO-RECONCILIATION-001 artifact was absent at the stale checkout and present after fast-forward. Worktree was clean. Fast-forward to a40d9030 succeeded.
incidents.notes: Proves the family exists; does not by itself prove recurrence. Grounding v0.1 would have stopped a file_exists claim for docs/audit/vectorizer_cross_repo_reconciliation_001.md at HEAD on the stale checkout (later confirmed MATCH exists=false at 8d0e1ecf and exists=true at a40d9030). Fetch-sensitive work began before that Grounding run. Classified as existing control not invoked early enough, not circular justification for Agent 002.

incidents.description: Handoff instructed creation of the Grounding trial ledger. PR #326 had already merged that ledger to main minutes earlier. Grounding returned STALE/STOP (GA-TRIAL-0001) and prevented a redundant create.
incidents.notes: Existing Grounding authority caught this. Cannot be used by itself to justify Agent 002.

incidents.description: A later session inherited five load-bearing claims from a prior session. The claims were re-derived rather than adopted. Two of five did not survive (POS-006 as a prior-prohibition; svgwrite as the Graduation Step 0 cause). The committed reconciliation states the transferable rule: a handoff preserves claims, not their epistemic status.
incidents.notes: Sandbox was not mounted in the 002A environment. Sandbox-side details are taken only from the committed Toolbox reconciliation record and are not independently re-measured here. Grounding v0.1 has no content-claim type, so it could not have checked these claims. A written re-derivation rule already exists in the reconciliation; whether that rule or a later Grounding claim type is sufficient is not established by a second independent incident.
